top_signals.title: Copper Erases Brief Nvidia Bounce on Demand and Rate Concerns
top_signals.summary: Copper erased a one-day gain sparked by Jensen Huang’s return to Nvidia Corp., with prices tumbling back toward the $12,000-a-ton level in London as demand and interest-rate concerns returned to the fore.

top_signals.summary: Welcome back to City AM‘s FTSE 100 liveblog. top_signals.title: Electric and Hybrid Cars Capture Three-Quarters of Europe’s Auto Market
top_signals.summary: Electric and hybrid vehicle sales across Europe dominated total car sales last month, representing around 75% of all new vehicle registrations, while gasoline and diesel car sales dropped, highlighting demand sensitivity to soaring energy commodity prices. The data comes from the European Automobile Manufacturers’ Association, which reported that battery electric vehicle sales specifically represented 29.8% of the total and plug-in hybrids accounted for 10.9% of the total in the European Union alone.
